verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־ עָרַ֣בְתָּ לְרֵעֶ֑ךָ תָּקַ֖עְתָּ לַזָּ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’im- ‘ā·raḇ·tā lə·rê·‘e·ḵā tā·qa‘·tā laz·zār kap·pe·ḵā
verses.literal: My son if you have put up security for your neighbor if you have struck hands in pledge . . . with a stranger
verses.literalPt: FILHO meu, se ficaste por fiador do teu companheiro, se deste a tua mão ao estranho,

verses.original: נוֹקַ֥שְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי־ פִ֑יךָ נִ֝לְכַּ֗דְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·qaš·tā ḇə·’im·rê- p̄î·ḵā nil·kaḏ·tā bə·’im·rê- p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: if you have been trapped by the words of your lips ensnared by the words of your mouth
verses.literalPt: E te deixaste enredar pelas próprias palavras; e te prendeste nas palavras da tua boca;

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֨ה זֹ֥את אֵפ֪וֹא׀ בְּנִ֡י וְֽהִנָּצֵ֗ל כִּ֘י בָ֤אתָ בְכַף־ רֵעֶ֑ךָ לֵ֥ךְ הִ֝תְרַפֵּ֗ס וּרְהַ֥ב רֵעֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śêh zōṯ ’ê·p̄ō·w bə·nî wə·hin·nā·ṣêl kî ḇā·ṯā ḇə·ḵap̄- rê·‘e·ḵā lêḵ hiṯ·rap·pês ū·rə·haḇ rê·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: then do this my son to free yourself for you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands Go humble yourself and press your plea with your neighbor
verses.literalPt: Faze pois isto agora, filho meu, e livra-te, já que caíste nas mãos do teu companheiro: vai, humilha-te, e importuna o teu companheiro.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתֵּ֣ן שֵׁנָ֣ה לְעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּ֝תְנוּמָ֗ה לְעַפְעַפֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tit·tên šê·nāh lə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·ṯə·nū·māh lə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pe·ḵā
verses.literal: Allow no sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids
verses.literalPt: Não dês sono aos teus olhos, nem deixes adormecer as tuas pálpebras.

verses.original: הִ֭נָּצֵל כִּצְבִ֣י מִיָּ֑ד וּ֝כְצִפּ֗וֹר מִיַּ֥ד יָקֽוּשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hin·nā·ṣêl kiṣ·ḇî mî·yāḏ ū·ḵə·ṣip·pō·wr mî·yaḏ yā·qūš
verses.literal: Free yourself like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter like a bird from the snare of the fowler
verses.literalPt: Livra-te, como a gazela da mão do caçador, e como a ave da mão do passarinheiro.

verses.original: לֵֽךְ־ אֶל־ נְמָלָ֥ה עָצֵ֑ל רְאֵ֖ה דְרָכֶ֣יהָ וַחֲכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ- ’el- nə·mā·lāh ‘ā·ṣêl rə·’êh ḏə·rā·ḵe·hā wa·ḥă·ḵām
verses.literal: Walk in the manner of . . . the ant O slacker observe its ways and become wise
verses.literalPt: Vai ter com a formiga, ó preguiçoso; olha para os seus caminhos, e sê sábio.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵֽין־ לָ֥הּ קָצִ֗ין שֹׁטֵ֥ר וּמֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ’ên- lāh qā·ṣîn šō·ṭêr ū·mō·šêl
verses.literal: Without a commander without an overseer or ruler
verses.literalPt: Pois ela, não tendo chefe, nem guarda, nem dominador,

verses.original: תָּכִ֣ין בַּקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָ֑הּ אָגְרָ֥ה בַ֝קָּצִ֗יר מַאֲכָלָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: tā·ḵîn baq·qa·yiṣ laḥ·māh ’ā·ḡə·rāh ḇaq·qā·ṣîr ma·’ă·ḵā·lāh
verses.literal: it prepares its provisions in summer it gathers its food at harvest
verses.literalPt: Prepara no verão o seu pão; na sega ajunta o seu mantimento.

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַ֖י עָצֵ֥ל׀ תִּשְׁכָּ֑ב מָ֝תַ֗י תָּק֥וּם מִשְּׁנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay ‘ā·ṣêl tiš·kāḇ mā·ṯay tā·qūm miš·šə·nā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: How long will you lie there O slacker When will you get up from your sleep
verses.literalPt: Ó preguiçoso, até quando ficarás deitado? Quando te levantarás do teu sono?

verses.original: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט׀ חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: mə·‘aṭ šē·nôt̲ mə·‘aṭ tə·nū·mō·wṯ mə·‘aṭ ḥib·buq yā·ḏa·yim liš·kāḇ
verses.literal: A little sleep a little slumber a little folding of the hands to rest
verses.literalPt: Um pouco a dormir, um pouco a tosquenejar; um pouco a repousar de braços cruzados;

verses.original: וּבָֽא־ כִמְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵאשֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹֽרְךָ֗ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā- ḵim·hal·lêḵ rê·še·ḵā ū·maḥ·sō·rə·ḵā kə·’îš mā·ḡên
verses.literal: and poverty will come upon you like a robber and need like a bandit . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim sobrevirá a tua pobreza como o meliante, e a tua necessidade como um homem armado.

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם בְּ֭לִיַּעַל אִ֣ישׁ אָ֑וֶן ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ עִקְּשׁ֥וּת פֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām bə·lî·ya·‘al ’îš ’ā·wen hō·w·lêḵ ‘iq·qə·šūṯ peh
verses.literal: A worthless person a wicked man walks with a perverse mouth
verses.literalPt: O homem mau, o homem iníquo tem a boca pervertida.

verses.original: קֹרֵ֣ץ בְּ֭עֵינָו מֹלֵ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֑ו מֹ֝רֶ֗ה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: qō·rêṣ bə·ʿē·nå̄w mō·lêl bə·raḡ·lå̄w mō·reh bə·’eṣ·bə·‘ō·ṯāw
verses.literal: winking his eyes speaking with his feet and pointing with his fingers
verses.literalPt: Acena com os olhos, fala com os pés e faz sinais com os dedos.

verses.original: תַּֽהְפֻּכ֨וֹת׀ בְּלִבּ֗וֹ חֹרֵ֣שׁ רָ֣ע בְּכָל־ עֵ֑ת מְדָנִים יְשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ bə·lib·bōw ḥō·rêš rā‘ bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ mə·ḏå̄·nīm yə·šal·lê·aḥ
verses.literal: With deceit in his heart he devises evil he continually . . . sows discord
verses.literalPt: Há no seu coração perversidade, todo o tempo maquina mal; anda semeando contendas.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן פִּ֭תְאֹם יָב֣וֹא אֵיד֑וֹ פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên piṯ·’ōm yā·ḇō·w ’ê·ḏōw pe·ṯa‘ yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·’ên mar·pê
verses.literal: Therefore . . . calamity will come upon him suddenly in an instant he will be shattered beyond recovery
verses.literalPt: Por isso a sua destruição virá repentinamente; subitamente será quebrantado, sem que haja cura.

verses.original: שֶׁשׁ־ הֵ֭נָּה שָׂנֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝שֶׁ֗בַע תּוֹעֲבוֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šeš- hên·nāh śā·nê Yah·weh wə·še·ḇa‘ tō·ʿă·ḇōṯ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: There are six things that the LORD hates seven that are detestable to Him
verses.literalPt: Estas seis coisas o SENHOR odeia, e a sétima a sua alma abomina:

verses.original: עֵינַ֣יִם רָ֭מוֹת לְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝יָדַ֗יִם שֹׁפְכ֥וֹת דָּם־ נָקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·na·yim rā·mō·wṯ lə·šō·wn šā·qer wə·yā·ḏa·yim šō·p̄ə·ḵō·wṯ dām- nā·qî
verses.literal: haughty eyes a lying tongue hands that shed innocent blood
verses.literalPt: Olhos altivos, língua mentirosa, mãos que derramam sangue inocente,

verses.original: לֵ֗ב חֹ֭רֵשׁ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָ֑וֶן רַגְלַ֥יִם מְ֝מַהֲר֗וֹת לָר֥וּץ לָֽרָעָה׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ḥō·rêš maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ ’ā·wen raḡ·la·yim mə·ma·hă·rō·wṯ lā·rūṣ lå̄·rå̄·ʿå̄h
verses.literal: a heart that devises wicked schemes feet that run swiftly to evil
verses.literalPt: O coração que maquina pensamentos perversos, pés que se apressam a correr para o mal,

verses.original: יָפִ֣יחַ כְּ֭זָבִים עֵ֣ד שָׁ֑קֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ מְ֝דָנִ֗ים בֵּ֣ין אַחִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: yā·p̄î·aḥ kə·zā·ḇîm ‘êḏ šā·qer ū·mə·šal·lê·aḥ mə·ḏā·nîm bên ’a·ḥîm
verses.literal: a false witness who gives false testimony and one who stirs up discord among brothers
verses.literalPt: A testemunha falsa que profere mentiras, e o que semeia contendas entre irmãos.

verses.original: נְצֹ֣ר בְּ֭נִי מִצְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל־ תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ṣōr bə·nî miṣ·waṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’al- tiṭ·ṭōš tō·w·raṯ ’im·me·ḵā
verses.literal: My son keep your father’s commandment and do not forsake your mother’s teaching
verses.literalPt: Filho meu, guarda o mandamento de teu pai, e não deixes a lei da tua mãe;

verses.original: קָשְׁרֵ֣ם עַל־ לִבְּךָ֣ תָמִ֑יד עָ֝נְדֵ֗ם עַל־ גַּרְגְּרֹתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·šə·rêm ‘al- lib·bə·ḵā ṯā·mîḏ ‘ā·nə·ḏêm ‘al- gar·gə·rō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Bind them always upon your heart tie them around your neck
verses.literalPt: Ata-os perpetuamente ao teu coração, e pendura-os ao teu pescoço.

verses.original: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ֨׀ תַּנְחֶ֬ה אֹתָ֗ךְ בְּֽ֭שָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר עָלֶ֑יךָ וַ֝הֲקִיצ֗וֹתָ הִ֣יא תְשִׂיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·hiṯ·hal·leḵ·ḵā tan·ḥeh ’ō·ṯāḵ bə·šā·ḵə·bə·ḵā tiš·mōr ‘ā·le·ḵā wa·hă·qî·ṣō·w·ṯā hî ṯə·śî·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: When you walk they will guide you when you lie down they will watch over you when you awake they will speak to you
verses.literalPt: Quando caminhares, te guiará; quando te deitares, te guardará; quando acordares, falará contigo.

verses.original: כִּ֤י נֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה וְת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר וְדֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî nêr miṣ·wāh wə·ṯō·w·rāh ’ō·wr wə·ḏe·reḵ ḥay·yîm tō·wḵ·ḥō·wṯ mū·sār
verses.literal: For this commandment is a lamp this teaching is a light and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life
verses.literalPt: Porque o mandamento é lâmpada, e a lei é luz; e as repreensões da correção são o caminho da vida,

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאֵ֣שֶׁת רָ֑ע מֵֽ֝חֶלְקַ֗ת לָשׁ֥וֹן נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: liš·mā·rə·ḵā mê·’ê·šeṯ rā‘ mê·ḥel·qaṯ lā·šō·wn nā·ḵə·rî·yāh
verses.literal: to keep you from the evil woman from the smooth tongue of the adulteress
verses.literalPt: Para te guardarem da mulher vil, e das lisonjas da estranha.

verses.original: אַל־ תַּחְמֹ֣ד יָ֭פְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־ תִּ֝קָּֽחֲךָ֗ בְּעַפְעַפֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- taḥ·mōḏ yā·p̄ə·yāh bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā wə·’al- tiq·qā·ḥă·ḵā bə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pe·hā
verses.literal: Do not lust in your heart . . . for her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes
verses.literalPt: Não cobices no teu coração a sua formosura, nem te prendas aos seus olhos.

verses.original: כִּ֤י בְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֗ה עַֽד־ כִּכַּ֫ר לָ֥חֶם וְאֵ֥שֶׁת אִ֑ישׁ נֶ֖פֶשׁ יְקָרָ֣ה תָצֽוּד׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh zō·w·nāh ‘aḏ- kik·kar lā·ḥem wə·’ê·šeṯ ’îš ne·p̄eš yə·qā·rāh ṯā·ṣūḏ
verses.literal: For the levy of the prostitute is poverty . . . . . . and the adulteress . . . preys upon your very life
verses.literalPt: Porque por causa duma prostituta se chega a pedir um bocado de pão; e a adúltera anda à caça da alma preciosa.

verses.original: הֲיַחְתֶּ֤ה אִ֓ישׁ אֵ֬שׁ בְּחֵיק֑וֹ וּ֝בְגָדָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִשָּׂרַֽפְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yaḥ·teh ’îš ’êš bə·ḥê·qōw ū·ḇə·ḡā·ḏāw lō ṯiś·śā·rap̄·nāh
verses.literal: Can a man embrace . . . fire and his clothes not be burned
verses.literalPt: Porventura tomará alguém fogo no seu seio, sem que suas vestes se queimem?

verses.original: אִם־ יְהַלֵּ֣ךְ אִ֭ישׁ עַל־ הַגֶּחָלִ֑ים וְ֝רַגְלָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yə·hal·lêḵ ’îš ‘al- hag·ge·ḥā·lîm wə·raḡ·lāw lō ṯik·kā·we·nāh
verses.literal: Can a man walk on hot coals without scorching his feet
verses.literalPt: Ou andará alguém sobre brasas, sem que se queimem os seus pés?

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן הַ֭בָּא אֶל־ אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ לֹ֥א יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה כָּֽל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kên hab·bā ’el- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū lō yin·nā·qeh kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bāh
verses.literal: So is he who sleeps with . . . another man’s wife no one . . . who touches her will go unpunished
verses.literalPt: Assim ficará o que entrar à mulher do seu próximo; não será inocente todo aquele que a tocar.

verses.original: לֹא־ יָב֣וּזוּ לַ֭גַּנָּב כִּ֣י יִגְנ֑וֹב לְמַלֵּ֥א נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ כִּ֣י יִרְעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·ḇū·zū lag·gan·nāḇ kî yiḡ·nō·wḇ lə·mal·lê nap̄·šōw kî yir·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Men do not despise the thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger
verses.literalPt: Não se injuria o ladrão, quando furta para saciar-se, tendo fome;

verses.original: וְ֭נִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּ֣ם שִׁבְעָתָ֑יִם אֶת־ כָּל־ ה֖וֹן בֵּית֣וֹ יִתֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nim·ṣā yə·šal·lêm šiḇ·‘ā·ṯā·yim ’eṯ- kāl- hō·wn bê·ṯōw yit·tên
verses.literal: Yet if caught he must pay sevenfold he must give up all the wealth of his house
verses.literalPt: E se for achado pagará o tanto sete vezes; terá de dar todos os bens da sua casa.

verses.original: נֹאֵ֣ף אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲסַר־ לֵ֑ב מַֽשְׁחִ֥ית נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: nō·’êp̄ ’iš·šāh ḥă·sar- lêḇ maš·ḥîṯ nap̄·šōw hū ya·‘ă·śen·nāh
verses.literal: He who commits adultery . . . lacks judgment whoever does so destroys himself
verses.literalPt: Assim, o que adultera com uma mulher é falto de entendimento; aquele que faz isso destrói a sua alma.

verses.original: נֶֽגַע־ וְקָל֥וֹן יִמְצָ֑א וְ֝חֶרְפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִמָּחֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ne·ḡa‘- wə·qā·lō·wn yim·ṣā wə·ḥer·pā·ṯōw lō ṯim·mā·ḥeh
verses.literal: Wounds and dishonor will befall him and his reproach will never be wiped away
verses.literalPt: Achará castigo e vilipêndio, e o seu opróbrio nunca se apagará.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ קִנְאָ֥ה חֲמַת־ גָּ֑בֶר וְלֹֽא־ יַ֝חְמ֗וֹל בְּי֣וֹם נָקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- qin·’āh ḥă·maṯ- gā·ḇer wə·lō- yaḥ·mō·wl bə·yō·wm nā·qām
verses.literal: For jealousy enrages a husband . . . and he will show no mercy in the day of vengeance
verses.literalPt: Porque os ciúmes enfurecerão o marido; de maneira nenhuma perdoará no dia da vingança.

verses.original: לֹא־ יִ֭שָּׂא פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ כֹּ֑פֶר וְלֹֽא־ יֹ֝אבֶ֗ה כִּ֣י תַרְבֶּה־ שֹֽׁחַד׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- yiś·śā pə·nê ḵāl kō·p̄er wə·lō- yō·ḇeh kî ṯar·beh- šō·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: He will not be appeased . . . by any ransom or persuaded . . . by lavish gifts
verses.literalPt: Não aceitará nenhum resgate, nem se conformará por mais que aumentes os presentes.
